title: Anthropic Sonnet 5.5 Leak: 2 Million Token Context Competes with DeepSeek Aiming to Regain Cost-Effectiveness Crown
excerpt: Anthropic's latest Sonnet 5.5 model has been revealed, with an internal codename of "Fennec" (desert fox), and it is highly likely to be released next month. Ac
content_html:
Anthropic's latest Sonnet 5.5 model has been revealed, with an internal codename of "Fennec" (desert fox), and it is highly likely to be released next month. According to current leaked information, this model supports a maximum context window of 2 million tokens, with faster reasoning speed, lower latency, significantly improved long-context reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities, and greatly enhanced ability to call tools such as browsers and terminals. The overall performance is approaching that of the flagship Claude Fable 5, but the pricing will remain in the Sonnet tier, aiming to become the new king of cost-effectiveness.

The current context window for Sonnet 5 is 1 million tokens, and the official statement clearly states that 1M is both the default and the maximum value. Doubling it to 2 million will directly benefit developers dealing with large code repositories and long document collections. Sonnet 5 is already the model that Anthropic focuses on agent capabilities, with the ability to make plans, use browsers and terminal tools, and run autonomously. If Sonnet 5.5 further improves tool interaction, productivity will see a significant leap. According to the leak, the model development has entered the final stage, and its capability positioning directly targets DeepSeek V4 Flash, aiming to occupy an attractive price-performance intersection between mainstream models and high-end advanced systems.

The Cost-Effectiveness Battle Redefines the Landscape of Large Model Competition

Competition among large models is no longer limited to benchmark scores, but has shifted to a more practical dimension: how much intelligence can users get for every yuan they spend. After DeepSeek V4 Flash disrupted the market with its ultra-low pricing, overseas major companies have felt pressure. Anthropic's release of Sonnet 5.5 is a direct response to this trend. If the leaked information is true, providing near-Fable 5 reasoning capabilities at the Sonnet price level will give Claude strong competitiveness in terms of cost-effectiveness.

It is worth noting that the most cost-effective Haiku series from Anthropic has not been updated for about a year, and the market has almost forgotten it. Combined with OpenAI's impressive performance on the Luna small model, some analysts believe that Anthropic plans to let Sonnet take over the position originally belonging to Haiku, covering the mid-range market with stronger capabilities. If this strategy succeeds, it will not only compress DeepSeek's price advantage space but also avoid internal competition within the product line. However, the challenge Anthropic faces is that DeepSeek has already established a low-price mindset, while OpenAI's Luna is rapidly capturing lightweight scenarios. Whether Sonnet 5.5 can truly claim the throne of cost-effectiveness amid multiple pressures remains to be seen at its official release next month.

content_html_zh:
Anthropic最新的Sonnet 5.5型号已经曝光，内部代号为“Fennec”（沙漠之狐），极有可能在下个月发布。 根据目前泄露的信息，该模型支持最大200万个token的上下文窗口，推理速度更快，延迟更低，长上下文推理和多步规划能力显着提升，调用浏览器、终端等工具的能力大幅增强。 整体性能逼近旗舰克劳德神鬼寓言5，但定价仍维持在Sonnet层级，志在成为新的性价比之王。

Sonnet 5 当前的上下文窗口是 100 万个代币，官方声明明确指出 1M 既是默认值，也是最大值。 加倍到 200 万将直接让处理大型代码存储库和长文档集合的开发人员受益。 Sonnet 5已经是Anthropic主打代理能力的型号，具备制定计划、使用浏览器和终端工具、自主运行的能力。 如果Sonnet 5.5进一步改进工具交互，生产力将出现显着飞跃。 据爆料，该机型开发已进入最后阶段，其能力定位直指DeepSeek V4 Flash，旨在占据主流机型与高端先进系统之间具有吸引力的性价比交叉点。

性价比之战重新定义大模型竞争格局

大模型之间的竞争不再局限于基准分数，而是转向了更实用的维度：用户花的每一块钱能获得多少智能。 DeepSeek V4 Flash以其超低定价扰乱市场后，海外各大公司都感受到了压力。 Anthropic 发布的 Sonnet 5.5 就是对这一趋势的直接回应。 如果泄露的信息属实，在十四行诗的价格水平上提供接近神鬼寓言5的推理能力，将使克劳德在性价比方面拥有强大的竞争力。

值得注意的是，来自Anthropic的性价比最高的俳句系列已经有一年左右没有更新了，市场几乎已经忘记了它。 结合OpenAI在Luna小型号上的亮眼表现，有分析师认为Anthropic计划让Sonnet接替原本属于Haiku的位置，以更强的能力覆盖中端市场。 如果这一策略成功，不仅会压缩DeepSeek的价格优势空间，还能避免产品线内部的竞争。 然而Anthropic面临的挑战是，DeepSeek已经建立了低价思维，而OpenAI的Luna正在快速捕捉轻量级场景。 Sonnet 5.5能否在多重压力下真正登上性价比宝座，还有待下个月正式发布。
